title: Mixed Declarations
subtitle: Combine constants, booleans, and decimal values while hazards speed up.
objective: Stay accurate under pressure by collecting the needed tokens and arranging each declaration correctly.

rounds.prompt: Build a valid constant declaration for MAX_STUDENTS.
hints: A constant starts with final before the type.
MAX_STUDENTS is written in uppercase here as a constant name.
The value comes after the equals sign.

rounds.prompt: Build a valid boolean variable declaration for hasPassed.
hints: Boolean variables use true or false without quotation marks.
The variable name should describe a yes-or-no state.
Use a semicolon to finish the statement.

rounds.prompt: Build a valid double variable declaration for averageScore.
hints: Double variables can store decimal values like 87.5.
Java decimals use a period, not a comma.
Put the variable name between the type and equals sign.
